column1: # Benchmark routes for scripts/bench.py: name, DM_KEYS (seconds from host start), measuring window start and length (s), description.
# From an empty save (the default): the title is up at about 45-50 s on a base M4 (40 s on an M4 Pro) and takes A at 60 s; the prologue cinematic (the game's own 30 fps) runs to about 330 s,
# when the tutorial asks whether to customize the controls: LDown, A answers no. The tutorial asks again every half minute or so of the ring course, so each 10 s of the stick pattern ends
# with LDown and A (no again, or a shot while flying). A save kept from a run replays the prologue.

column5: the prologue, then the tutorial's ring course under a repeated stick pattern (left, right, up, down, A every 10 s), the controls question answered each time it comes back; the game's upscaler network runs every frame
the title screen, no input: a still scene with the game's upscaler network every frame (DM_UPSCALER compares in a minute)
